title: Jewish Solidarity
subtitle:
Mutual aid networks and community support initiatives focused on Jewish solidarity,
                    anti-fascist organizing, and collective resistance.

initiatives.name: Jewish Zine Archive
initiatives.description: Physical and digital archive of zines by Jewish writers and artists, housed at the Blacklidge Community Collective in Tucson, AZ. It accepts zine submissions and runs the Jewish Zine Fest.

initiatives.name: International Jewish Antizionist Network (IJAN)
initiatives.description: International network of anti-Zionist Jews with chapters in several countries. Does education, campaigns, and actions in support of Palestinian rights.
